StockAuditSession.title: StockAuditSession
StockAuditSession.description: Represents a 4-step Stock-Taking Audit Session assigned to a specific warehouse or retail shop branch, including the baseline expected ERP inventory snapshot, rapid universal barcode scanned counts, discrepancy/variance calculations, and audit approval status.

branchId.description: Assigned branch ID (warehouse or retail shop)

status.description: Current workflow step of the stock audit session

auditorId.description: Employee/User ID of the stock manager or auditor

auditorName.description: Name of the auditor conducting the scan loop

startedAt.description: ISO timestamp when Step 1 baseline snapshot was initialized

completedScanningAt.description: ISO timestamp when physical scanning completed

approvedAt.description: ISO timestamp when senior manager approved the audit

approvedBy.description: Name and role of the store owner or senior manager who approved

totalSkusInBaseline.description: Total SKUs snapshotted from ERP baseline

totalExpectedUnits.description: Total expected bottles across snapshotted SKUs

totalScannedUnits.description: Total physical bottles scanned in the loop

itemsMapJson.description: Serialized map of SKU audit entries (baseline expected count, scanned count, universal barcode, bottle size, unit cost)

recentScansJson.description: Serialized array of most recent barcode scan events in the rapid scanning loop

StockAdjustmentLog.title: StockAdjustmentLog
StockAdjustmentLog.description: Automated stock adjustment log generated upon approving a Stock Audit Session for auditing accountability.

auditSessionId.description: Reference to the parent StockAuditSession ID

branchId.description: Branch ID where ledger was adjusted

productName.description: Product display name including bottle size

expectedErpCount.description: Baseline ERP expected count before adjustment

physicalScannedCount.description: Physical count from rapid barcode scanning loop

variance.description: Variance = Physical Count - Expected ERP Count

discrepancyFlag.description: SHRINKAGE_LOSS if physical < expected, SURPLUS_REVIEW if physical > expected

unitCostKes.description: Unit cost in KES for financial variance valuation

auditorName.description: Auditor who performed the physical count

approvedBy.description: Store owner or senior manager who approved the ledger adjustment

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of approval and ledger adjustment

BranchInventoryLedger.title: BranchInventoryLedger
BranchInventoryLedger.description: Live branch inventory ledger synchronized in Firebase Firestore.

quantity.description: Live physical stock quantity in bottles

lastAuditSessionId.description: Last audit session that verified or adjusted this SKU

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last ledger update

InventoryTransaction.title: InventoryTransaction
InventoryTransaction.description: Immutable inventory ledger movement recording every stock addition, deduction, transfer, return, or adjustment.

quantity.description: Signed or absolute quantity of units moved

referenceId.description: Document or transaction reference ID (e.g. ORD-..., TRF-..., PO-...)

userId.description: Authenticated user ID who executed the transaction

reason.description: Mandatory business reason for movement or adjustment

SaleRecord.title: SaleRecord
SaleRecord.description: Authoritative POS or Storefront sale record validated by the backend.

JournalEntryRecord.title: JournalEntryRecord
JournalEntryRecord.description: Immutable balanced double-entry accounting journal record.

totalDebitKes.description: Total debits in KES (must equal totalCreditKes)

totalCreditKes.description: Total credits in KES (must equal totalDebitKes)

AccountingPeriodRecord.title: AccountingPeriodRecord
AccountingPeriodRecord.description: Controls open/closed financial reporting periods to prevent unauthorized historical tampering.

closedBy.description: User ID who closed the period

reopenedBy.description: Super Admin ID who reopened the period

FiscalTransactionRecord.title: FiscalTransactionRecord
FiscalTransactionRecord.description: KRA eTIMS fiscal transaction lifecycle record with retry & failure tracking.

fiscalIdentifier.description: Control unit / fiscal invoice identifier when succeeded

errorCode.description: Upstream or gateway error code if failed

StockTransferRecord.title: StockTransferRecord
StockTransferRecord.description: Formal inter-branch stock transfer workflow record.

itemsJson.description: Serialized list of transferred products and quantities

receivedBy.description: Receiving branch user who confirmed receipt

AuditLogRecord.title: AuditLogRecord
AuditLogRecord.description: Centralized immutable enterprise audit log with before/after snapshots.

entityType.description: Target entity type (SALE, INVENTORY, INVOICE, PERIOD, USER, etc.)

StaffDirectoryRecord.title: StaffDirectoryRecord
StaffDirectoryRecord.description: Independent staff database record storing staff & sales representative hashed credentials, department, branch assignment, commission configuration, statutory HR profile, and real-time operational data.

id.description: Unique staff or affiliate ID (e.g. emp-12345 or aff-12345)

recordType.description: Whether the staff record is a core ERP Employee or a Sales Representative Affiliate

name.description: Full name of the staff member

codeOrNumber.description: Employee number (e.g. EMP-101) or Sales Rep code (e.g. SR-JANE-01)

pinHash.description: Salted SHA-256 hash of the 6-digit PIN

pinSalt.description: Cryptographic random salt for PIN hashing

commissionMode.description: Commission calculation mode for Sales Representatives

allowPreferredPrice.description: Whether preferred selling prices are enabled

assignedCashierId.description: Assigned POS Counter Cashier ID for Sales Reps

totalSalesKes.description: Cumulative sales attributed to this staff member in KES

companySalesTotalKes.description: Company baseline sales total in KES

preferredPriceProfitTotalKes.description: Preferred price markup profit total in KES

baseCommissionTotalKes.description: Base percentage commission total in KES

paidCommissionKes.description: Total commission already paid out in KES

pendingCommissionKes.description: Current unpaid pending commission in KES

basicSalaryKes.description: Basic monthly salary in KES for salaried staff

preferredPricesJson.description: Serialized JSON map of per-product preferred prices

staffDataJson.description: Serialized JSON snapshot of staff personal workspace data

active.description: Whether the staff account is active for login

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent terminal login

loginCount.description: Total number of instant logins recorded

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last database sync

UserActivityLog.title: UserActivityLog
UserActivityLog.description: Real-time audit log of user activities across all ERP dashboards, including logins, logouts, sales, statement generation, and device telemetry.

actionTitle.description: Short summary of the user activity

module.description: Dashboard or module where the action occurred

deviceUsed.description: Device, browser, OS, and viewport used

UserSessionMonitorRecord.title: UserSessionMonitorRecord
UserSessionMonitorRecord.description: Live session and login telemetry record per user, tracking active login state, last login timestamp, login count, latest activity action, and device used.

isActiveLogin.description: Whether the user currently has an active login session

activeLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp when current active login started

lastHeartbeatAt.description: ISO timestamp of latest session activity

lastActionTitle.description: Title of the user's most recent activity action

lastActionDetails.description: Details of the user's most recent activity action

lastActionAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent activity action

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last session monitor update

UnifiedStateDocument.title: UnifiedStateDocument
UnifiedStateDocument.description: Stores unified ERP state collections in Firestore for real-time cross-device and cross-module data unification.

payloadJson.description: Serialized JSON payload of the unified ERP collection

recordCount.description: Number of records in this state collection

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last unification sync

updatedBy.description: User or system engine that published the update

deviceOrigin.description: Client instance ID that published the update

OrganizationRecord.title: OrganizationRecord
OrganizationRecord.description: First-class multi-tier B2B network organization entity (Merchant, Distributor, Retailer, or Supplier).

OrganizationMembershipRecord.title: OrganizationMembershipRecord
OrganizationMembershipRecord.description: Relational link binding User -> Membership -> Organization -> Role.

role.description: Role held by the user within the organization

joinedAt.description: ISO timestamp when membership was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when membership was last updated

ConsumerRecord.title: ConsumerRecord
ConsumerRecord.description: First-class individual customer identity for B2C Storefront and Retail POS buyers.

active.description: Whether the consumer profile is active

MpesaTransactionRecord.title: MpesaTransactionRecord
MpesaTransactionRecord.description: Authoritative Safaricom Daraja STK Push & C2B transaction record storing pending initiation, callback verification, and reconciliation status.

confirmedAmountKes.description: Confirmed payment amount from Daraja callback/query

status.description: Lifecycle status of the Daraja transaction

callbackSignatureToken.description: Cryptographic HMAC token verifying callback authenticity

rawCallbackPayload.description: Immutable JSON string of the Daraja callback or query payload

reconciledToOrderId.description: Order ID this payment was reconciled against

UserTotpFactorRecord.title: UserTotpFactorRecord
UserTotpFactorRecord.description: Server-controlled per-user TOTP MFA factor record binding an individual user (UID + email) to their isolated RFC 6238 TOTP secret or Firebase TOTP MFA factor.

userId.description: Firebase UID or ERP User ID

mfaEnabled.description: Whether per-user TOTP MFA is active

enrolledAt.description: ISO timestamp when factor was enrolled

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when factor was updated

/userTotpFactors/{userId}.description: Stores server-controlled per-user TOTP MFA factor records.

/organizations/{orgId}.description: Stores first-class Organizations (Merchant, Distributor, Retailer, Supplier).

/organizationMemberships/{membershipId}.description: Stores relational User -> Membership -> Organization -> Role records.

/consumers/{consumerId}.description: Stores first-class individual Consumer customer identities.

/stockAuditSessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores active and historical stock-taking audit sessions per branch.

/stockAdjustmentLogs/{logId}.description: Stores immutable stock adjustment audit trail logs created when an audit is approved.

/branchInventoryLedgers/{ledgerId}.description: Stores live branch inventory quantities synchronized with the ERP.

/inventoryTransactions/{txId}.description: Stores immutable inventory ledger movements for every stock change across branches.

/sales/{saleId}.description: Stores authoritative server-validated POS and storefront sales.

/journalEntries/{entryId}.description: Stores balanced double-entry accounting journal entries.

/accountingPeriods/{periodId}.description: Stores open and closed financial accounting periods.

/fiscalTransactions/{fiscalId}.description: Stores KRA eTIMS fiscalization lifecycle records and retry states.

/stockTransfers/{transferId}.description: Stores formal inter-branch stock transfer workflows.

/auditLogs/{auditId}.description: Stores centralized immutable enterprise audit logs with before/after snapshots.

/staffDirectory/{staffId}.description: Independent staff database collection storing hashed staff credentials, roles, and branch assignments.

/userActivityLogs/{logId}.description: Stores real-time chronological user activity logs across all ERP dashboards.

/userSessionMonitors/{userId}.description: Stores live user login, active session, latest activity, and device telemetry per user.

/erpUnifiedState/{stateKey}.description: Stores unified ERP state across all system modules and database collections.

/unifiedStateStore/{stateKey}.description: Authoritative central cloud store for unified ERP master and operational state across all browsers and devices.

/mpesaTransactions/{checkoutRequestId}.description: Stores authoritative Safaricom Daraja STK Push and C2B payment transactions with immutable callback records.
